name: Start: 2550 W Logan Blvd, Chicago
desc: Roll out ~4:15 PM CT Tue Nov 24 after 2 to 4 PM Deljo furnace check.

name: Fair Oaks Farms (I-65 Exit 220)
desc: Great halfway stretch on Leg 1 with wide perimeter lawns for Winston (pets stay outside buildings).

name: Staybridge Suites Greenwood (I-65 Exit 99)
desc: Verified <80 lbs dog-friendly ($75 fee), $131/nt Adv / $154 Flex, full kitchen & free hot breakfast.

name: Best Western Plus Greenwood (I-65 Exit 99)
desc: CONFIRMED TONIGHT (Tue Nov 24)! 1281 S Park Dr (Exit 99), 1 King Bed w/ sofabed, microwave, mini-fridge & free full breakfast; 80 lb max ($25 pet fee), check-out 11 AM ET. Call (317) 865-0100 en route to assign pet room.

name: La Quinta Columbus-Edinburgh (I-65 Exit 76B)
desc: Best overall budget corridor pick! 4.2 stars, verified <=75 lbs ($25 fee), free hot breakfast (~$116 to $125 all-in, trims 25 min off Day 2!).

name: Oaken Barrel Brewing Co. (Greenwood)
desc: Cozy Indiana comfort food right near I-65 Exit 99 Greenwood.

name: Revery (Old Town Greenwood)
desc: Warm modern American dining in downtown Greenwood.

name: Buc-ee's Smiths Grove, KY (I-65 Exit 38)
desc: Spotless restrooms, brisket & snacks. Strict no-pets-inside policy: tag-team walk Winston on outer grass.

name: Historic Downtown Franklin Main Street
desc: Flat brick sidewalks, Better Cities for Pets green paw stickers, and water bowls outside boutiques!

name: Frothy Monkey (Downtown Franklin)
desc: All-day cafe inside a historic church manse with spacious dog-friendly patio.

name: Merridee's Breadbasket
desc: Iconic Franklin scratch bakery for cinnamon rolls, soup, sandwiches & outdoor seating.

name: McGavock's Coffee Bar (The Harpeth)
desc: Streetside dog-friendly coffee & pastry patio at the edge of Main Street.

name: Finnley's Good Findings
desc: Chic Main Street clothing & accessory boutique welcoming leashed dogs inside.

name: Hester & Cook (Main St Franklin)
desc: Beautiful paper goods, table linens, and gifts (dog-friendly!).

name: Anthropologie (Historic Franklin)
desc: Gorgeous historic Main Street storefront welcoming leashed pups.

name: Puckett's Grocery & Restaurant
desc: Legendary Southern comfort food, live music, and dog-friendly patio seating.

name: Americana Taphouse
desc: Elevated tavern classics with a spacious shaded creekside patio for Winston.

name: The Park at Harlinsdale Farm (K-9 Korral)
desc: 5 min from Main St: huge fenced off-leash dog park for Winston zoomies!

name: Drury Plaza Hotel Nashville Franklin
desc: 4.7 stars! Verified 80 lb combined limit ($65+tax fee), ~$206 OTA / ~$244 member direct with FREE hot breakfast + FREE 5:30 PM Kickback dinner & drinks!

name: Candlewood Suites Nashville - Franklin
desc: Lowest clean all-in & closest to Main St (2.2 mi / 5 min)! 4.5 stars, verified 80 lb max ($75 fee), full kitchen (~$167 OTA / ~$192 direct all-in).

name: Walnut Street Pedestrian Bridge
desc: Reopened Oct 3, 2026! Iconic flat wooden-plank pedestrian bridge high over the Tennessee River.

name: Bluff View Art District & Sculpture Garden
desc: Ivy-covered cobblestone lanes, outdoor River Gallery Sculpture Garden, and Rembrandts courtyard.

name: Coolidge Park (NorthShore)
desc: Wide flat grassy riverfront park right across Walnut Street Bridge for Winston.

name: Frazier Avenue Shops (Almanac Supply & Plum Nelly)
desc: Cute NorthShore indie boutique strip (window-shop Thanksgiving Day & bookmark for our weekend trip back!).

name: Point Park Overlook (Lookout Mountain)
desc: Optional 10-min scenic drive up Lookout Mountain for sweeping valley views right from the car.

name: Elsie's Daughter (Chattanooga Choo Choo)
desc: Backup Thanksgiving lunch: 3-course prix fixe ($95/adult), open 2:00 & 2:15 PM ET.

name: Buc-ee's Calhoun, GA (I-75 Exit 310)
desc: Halfway between Chattanooga and Trilith. Spotless restrooms & snacks (walk Winston on perimeter grass).

name: Trilith Guesthouse & Prologue Thanksgiving Feast
desc: Boutique Marriott Tribute hotel (<=75 lbs dog approved!). Prologue Thanksgiving Feast 11 AM to 6 PM ET ($70/adult, last seating 5 PM).

name: Harvest & Grace (Town at Trilith)
desc: Specialty lattes & scratch breakfast with spacious dog-friendly patio (water stations & leash tie-downs!).

name: Woodstone Bakery & Cafe (Town at Trilith)
desc: Fresh pastries and espresso steps from Trilith Guesthouse.

name: Welcome Home: 306 Calgary Drive, Peachtree City
desc: Only 15 min from Trilith! Tall Georgia pines, fenced backyard pool, and 100+ miles of golf-cart paths.

name: Historic Main Street Senoia (15 min south)
desc: Adorable nearby Georgia Main Street with indie boutiques, porches, and coffee shops.

name: Serenbe Village (22 min NW)
desc: Artsy farm-to-table village with wooded trails, weekend farmers markets, and cozy cafes.
